newsitem.title: UK: Panama sees higher economic growth this year.
newsitem.headline: Panama sees higher economic growth this year.

text.p: Panama's economic growth is likely to reach four percent this year and will be even higher in 1998, President Perez Balladares said on Tuesday.
Balladares, in London on an official visit, told a news conference that the expected increases were due to structural economic adjustment and follow two relatively slow years.
The economy grew just 19 percent last year.
Balladares also said that the country's $500 million Eurobond issue, which was priced on Monday, had been favourably received.
"It has been very sucessful," he said without giving any -- Andrew Gill, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7770 (fax +44 171 583 7239)
